tagline: Guide an ever-growing snake through tight turns and faster mistakes.
gameplaySummary: Snake Classic is a score-chasing arcade run where every apple extends your length, shrinks your margin for error, and asks you to plan two or three moves ahead.

difficulty.summary: The first minute is approachable, but long runs become a routing puzzle as your snake fills more of the board.

tips: Stay close to the center early so you can pivot into any lane quickly.
Avoid trapping yourself in the corners unless you already know your exit path.
If your version stores scores in localStorage, this page will show your browser record automatically.
